Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround. Answering inline: 

1) Naming: We can accept "Redwood Inference, Inc. and its affiliates" as long as the named insured block in the endorsement includes the parent legal entity. The main purpose is to avoid missing the specific legal entity that will be indemnified.

2) Waiver of subrogation: Preferred but not a blocker. If the carrier cannot provide a waiver, we ask for a written exception from the carrier or confirmation that the waiver will be provided for claims arising from Bluewave's use of our service.

3) Primary & noncontributory: We require primary & noncontributory for liabilities arising out of the services under the Order Form. If Atlas needs language, I attached a DRAFT endorsement (Endorsement_DRAFT.pdf) with suggested verbiage.

If helpful, below is a short endorsement paragraph you can share with Atlas: 
"
The insurer hereby agrees to name Redwood Inference, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates as an Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the Named Insured's operations, products or services performed for the Additional Insured under written contract. Coverage afforded to the Additional Insured shall be primary and noncontributory to any insurance maintained by the Additional Insured.
"

If Atlas can confirm they can provide either that endorsement or an equivalent ISO endorsement within 30 days of effective date, we can proceed with signature.

Thanks — I will hold execution until we get confirmation to avoid needing an amendment after signature.

Best,
Alex

- Limits: hold to 1,000,000 per occurrence / 2,000,000 aggregate for CGL; 1,000,000 for Auto. Cyber exclusions are acceptable (we don't require cyber coverage for this engagement).
